title: Story duration
description: How much story time a stretch of text covers (Genette's duration). Approximate by design: a magnitude in one unit, a range, zero (a pause: text, but the story does not advance), or explicitly unknown. Absent means the producer stayed silent.

value.description: Approximate magnitude in `unit`. 0 marks a pause.

unknown.description: True when the text gives no way to tell how much time passes. Then no unit or magnitude.
